npcs.name: Captain Brenna
npcs.greeting: Keep your voice down. The wyrm sleeps on that gold — for now.
lines: Two waves of its servants, then it wakes. Be ready when the floor starts to shake.
When it takes to the air, it only breathes fire. Keep moving, and never stand still in the light.
The brutes guarding the hoard hit hard. Freeze them, then break them.
npcs.persona: A scarred veteran of the dragon wars; calm, low-voiced, protective of new casters.

npcs.name: Grimble
npcs.greeting: Potions! Blades! Very reasonable prices, considering where we are.

intro.title: The Dragon's Keep
intro.speaker: Captain Brenna
intro.text:
Deep inside the old keep, the Emberwyrm sleeps on a mountain of stolen gold.

Its servants guard the hall. Hold them off for two waves — on the third, the wyrm wakes.

When it does: bring it down.

outro.title: The Wyrm Falls
outro.speaker: Captain Brenna
outro.text:
It is over. The keep is quiet for the first time in a hundred years.

Take what you can carry — you earned it.
